instrument: Intuitive Eating Scale-3 Chinese university adaptation
measured_scales: Unconditional permission to eat; physical versus emotional eating; reliance on hunger/satiety; body-food choice congruence
research_population: China university respondents N=1307, gender measurement invariance and 4-week retest
respondent_language_status: Chinese respondent-form adaptation validated by administered data (ZH-CN); exact simplified-character item approval pending
independently_validated_translation: yes: one Chinese translation of IES-3 original (not a UI translation)
commercial_digital_rights: permission_required: owner and Chinese translation holder must approve commercial digital questionnaire hosting/scoring
verification_and_safety: 2025 journal validation; alpha .83, test-retest .79; CFA 4 factors. Not commercial licensed. Not diagnostic.
